name: FaceFusion
description: FaceFusion web UI. Finished videos are written on the dyno at storage/output.

WEB_CONCURRENCY.description: Keep a single web process. FaceFusion is not a multi-worker app.

FACEFUSION_OUTPUT_PATH.description: Dyno directory where output videos and images are saved.

FACEFUSION_TEMP_PATH.description: Scratch frames while a video is processing.

FACEFUSION_THREADS.description: CPU threads. Keep this at 1 unless the dyno has several cores.
